# SymPy issues reviewed

Every SymPy issue reviewed against SymJ (and problems found in passing, `rN-extra-k`), as the tracker's "All issues" tab. *SymJ?*: whether SymJ shared the problem; *fix*: the cause it was grouped under (see [README.md](README.md) for its status) or the missing feature. Newest issues first within each round.

| [30900](https://github.com/sympy/sympy/issues/30900) | 1 | open | n/a | feature gap | SymJ | matrix-expressions | Review of the matrices module: 179 verified defects, mostly in matrices.expressions | Umbrella review, mostly matrices.expressions (MatrixSymbol, BlockMatrix, refine with Q.*), which SymJ lacks; explicit-matrix items not individually checked. |
